# Samsø

Samsø is a Danish municipality named in the AFDK 2024 report as part of "Aarhusklyngen" (the Aarhus cluster), one of the geographic health clusters participating in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark) [^src1]. The mention appears in a chapter documenting Indikator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse), which surveys structured patient education for atrial fibrillation across Danish health clusters, drawing on ESC guidelines and the ABC Pathway model for integrated atrial fibrillation care [^src1]. Beyond this listing, no further details about Samsø are available in the corpus.
